description: Perform a free multi-chain (Base, Ethereum, Solana) token security, EIP-1967 proxy resolution, honeypot, and buy/sell tax audit. Use this as the primary pre-trade check for any token or contract (100 free calls/day/IP, zero API key; then $0.005 USDC). Returns score, verdict, recommendedAgentAction, proxy implementation, tax percentages, LP USD, and provenance block number (<400 tokens). Do NOT use for low-level 4-byte selector disassembly on non-token contracts (use nullclear_inspect_contract) or when an EIP-712 Bazaar payment receipt is explicitly required on Base ERC-20 tokens (use nullclear_audit_paid_token).

address.description: Token or contract address (0x-prefixed 42-char EVM hex for Base/ETH, or Base58 mint address for Solana)

chain.description: Target blockchain network ('base', 'eth', or 'solana'); auto-detects if address exists on an alternate supported chain

name: nullclear_scan_token
